https://www.emsnow.com/sumitronics-has-e.text: Sumitronics Has Entered into a Strategic Partnership Agreement with CEMS HOLDING a.s. September 8, 2026 Asia , EMS , Europe , News Sumitronics Corporation (“Sumitronics”) has entered into a strategic partnership agreement with CEMS HOLDING a.s. (“CEMS”), a European Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) provider. Through this strategic partnership, the two companies aim to provide high-quality and reliable EMS solutions to both Japanese and global customers in the growing European market. By combining Sumitronics’ global customer base, component procurement capabilities, expertise in global supply chain management, and know-how in quality and production management with CEMS’ manufacturing operations in two European locations, the companies seek to expand business opportunities across Europe. Going forward, Sumitronics and CEMS will promote collaboration in manufacturing, engineering support, component procurement, and quality management, while delivering high value-added EMS-centered solutions throughout the region. About CEMS: Company Name: CEMS HOLDING a.s. (Number of employees: 365) Head Office: Špitálka 539/23e, Trnitá, 602 00 Brno, Czech Republic Representative: Radek Nekarda Company Overview: CEMS Holding is an Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) company with operations in Central Europe (the Czech Republic and Slovakia). The company offers an integrated range of services covering product development, prototyping, mass production, logistics arrangements, and repair services, serving a broad range of applications including automotive and industrial equipment.
